g.text: Queue 2: windows waiting for the decoder
one batch: up to B from the front
on a GPU, one window size per batch
First come, first served: nothing overtakes,
and whatever does not fit waits at the front.
A caller who hangs up leaves both queues.
A batch that fails, fails only its own callers.
Narrow windows: a stream's first second, or a tail.
each window goes to its own caller's outbox, in order, with the sentence's pause after its last window

g.text: (a) Callers, the two queues and the GPU

text.font-family: DejaVu Serif, Times New Roman, serif

g.text: B = best_batch_size(); Q1, Q2: first come, first served
new ← every call waiting in the inbox
plan new in one batch, so each sentence's
add each new call's sentences to the back of Q1
remove entries of callers that hung up or failed
S ← up to B sentences from the front of Q1
think(S); add each sentence's windows to the
W ← up to B windows from the front of Q2;
on a GPU, stop at a window of another size
decode(W); send each window to its caller's outbox
after a sentence's last window, send its pause
when a caller has nothing left, send DONE
if the inbox, Q1 and Q2 are empty, sleep until
a call arrives; otherwise start the next turn
A failing step sends its error to the callers in its
batch only. Callers read their own outbox: stream()
yields each window as it arrives; say() returns after
DONE. Only the Playhead thread runs the model.
